name: open-adms
description: Open ADMS: offline-capable debris management and field reconciliation for disaster recovery.

scripts.lint: pnpm generate && NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 eslint --max-warnings 0 apps && NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 eslint --max-warnings 0 packages infra tools eslint.config.js vitest.config.js && prettier --check apps packages infra tools package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.json tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.js vitest.config.js
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages infra tools package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.json tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.js vitest.config.js
scripts.security: pnpm generate && tsc --build && pnpm --filter @open-adms/field build && pnpm --filter @open-adms/back-office build && node tools/security/src/index.ts
scripts.start: node tools/setup/src/index.ts install && node infra/local/src/index.ts up
scripts.start:blank: node tools/setup/src/index.ts install --no-sample && node infra/local/src/index.ts up
scripts.ready: node infra/local/src/index.ts up && node tools/setup/src/index.ts check
scripts.openapi: pnpm generate && tsc --build && node apps/api/src/openapi.ts && prettier --write apps/api/openapi.json
